prompt: Revise the referenced card illustration for 白云无尽 from Where Winds Meet, using its fan-healing spell's radiant lotus bloom as the visual focus. Keep the same adult female wuxia healer identity, long dark hair, refined jade-white flowing hanfu, folding fan and painterly realistic Chinese wuxia game aesthetic, normal adult proportions. Recompose as a dramatic three-quarter full-body view: she stands in the CENTER, holding her open fan at shoulder height, one palm gently extended; a HUGE RED MAGICAL LOTUS, wider than her body by three times, blossoms under and around her feet and lower body. The lotus is NOT a natural pond flower or a solid throne: it is a semi-transparent spell made of layered crimson-scarlet and rose-red luminous pointed lotus petals with bright ivory-white outlines, glowing white-gold core, inner petals upright, outer petals opening outward into a wide low ellipse in perspective. Delicate red petals spiral upward, a thin circular healing ripple expands horizontally beneath it, translucent warm red light wraps sleeves and fabric. Echo the healing fan gameplay bloom: flower unfolding, healing wave radiating, scattered petals fading. She must remain clearly visible above and among the petals, face and main flower inside central safe area. Remove the large seated foreground patient to give the lotus room; a few tiny resting allies can be far in the mist. Cool misty river valley, distant Chinese mountains and bamboo silhouettes for contrast against the luminous red lotus, cinematic pale silver-jade ambient light with rich red focal glow, serene restorative energy, NOT fiery aggressive explosion, no flames, no blood, no sinister corruption. 1:1 square full-bleed illustration. NO lettering, no Chinese characters, no title, captions, logo, UI, border, frame, rarity, collage or speech bubbles. Keep original fantasy game proportions, not chibi, not anime mascot. Produce one complete standalone beautiful finished card illustration.

layers.prompt: Extract ONLY the gigantic luminous RED MAGICAL LOTUS from the referenced illustration as an independent transparent VFX layer. Preserve the lotus exact perspective, alignment and size on the SAME square canvas: flower occupies mostly the lower half, center around 50 percent x, 75 percent y; pointed rear petals rise to mid-height, outer front petals spread toward bottom corners. The lotus must be layered translucent crimson-scarlet petals with bright ivory-white vein-like outlines and glowing white-gold heart, airborne restorative magical light, not an ordinary pond plant or solid crystal throne. Remove the female healer and all her fabric and fan, ALL humans, scenery, ground, mountains, flying ribbons and loose floating particles; inpaint the center and rear of the lotus naturally where her body occluded it. Keep ONLY the single coherent lotus flower, beautiful fine petal edges and soft restrained glow, alpha transparent outside it and through petal gaps. No drawn checkerboard, no green foliage, no black background, no text or frame. Do not enlarge, shift or recenter the lotus on the canvas; original alignment is essential for animation.
